# Preface {.unnumbered}

> _Placeholder: a sentence or two on the purpose of this book and what readers
> will be able to do after reading it._

This book documents the `vrm` package: a general-purpose toolkit for Bayesian
and frequentist regression analysis workflows. The chapters move from
installation and basic usage through model fitting, posterior prediction and
marginal effects, and finally visualization.
